name: Solude
source:
Solude is an angel who is part of the imperial guard of Flaithis. He is a calm and generous person, who holds individual values which are unique for an angel. Inside he has a romanticist's passionate heart, but becomes clumsy or awkward when trying to express his feelings openly.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/fragrance/fragrance.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
